primary_question.question: Why does my Tomato Rasam taste bitter or burnt?
evidence: Do not use too little water, or the dal may scorch.

related_questions.question: Why is my Tomato Rasam too spicy or bland?
evidence: Do not finely powder the dried red chilli unless you want extra heat.

related_questions.question: Why does the oil or fat stage matter for Tomato Rasam?
evidence: Do not boil on very high heat, or the liquid may reduce too much.

related_questions.question: Why does my Tomato Rasam stick or tear?
evidence: Do not let rasam powder stick to the bottom; stir after adding it.

related_questions.question: How can I improve my Tomato Rasam?
evidence: Do not open the cooker while it is still under pressure.
Do not use too little water, or the dal may scorch.
Do not leave the dal thick and lumpy, or the rasam will not blend well.
Do not finely powder the dried red chilli unless you want extra heat.
Do not boil on very high heat, or the liquid may reduce too much.
